paragraphs: R. Meyasha. There is another R. Meyasha who spoke with amoraim; accordingly consider who spoke in the early R. Meyasha's name. Or there is a distinction: one R. Meyasha, another R. Misha. R. Abba in his name, Jerusalem Talmud, Gittin 2, halakhah 3; R. Avin, Ḥullin 121a. R. Aḥa in his name, Jerusalem Talmud, Eruvin 1 and beginning of Bikkurim 1. R. Aḥa and R. Kohen in the Caesarean rabbis' name, Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat 8, halakhah 6. He spoke to R. Zeira, Ma'aserot, chapter [numeral missing], halakhah 2; R. Ḥizkiyah, R. Kohen and R. Yaakov bar Aḥa. R. Ḥiyya bar Yannai in his name. R. Ḥanina said: R. Meyasha said. In R. Yehudah bar Ilai's name, Nedarim 8b. He said: R. Yoḥanan asked, Shabbat 99b. In R. Yoḥanan's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat 1, halakhah 1. R. Yonah said: R. Meyasha said, Bikkurim 2, halakhah 4. In R. Yannai's name; R. Yaakov bar Aḥa (see above); and R. Yirmeyah. R. Abbahu said to R. Yirmeyah, 'Does the law follow us or you?' He answered, 'Us, for we are old and you are youngsters,' Bava Batra 142b. R. Kohen: see above. He told R. Shemuel bar Yitzḥak, 'Did our teacher not teach us thus?' Jerusalem Talmud, end of Berakhot 2. R. Yirmeyah in R. Shemuel bar Yitzḥak's name, Shekalim, beginning of chapter 3. R. Shimon bar Zevid.
